name: Roundcube
about: Roundcube is a browser-based, multilingual IMAP client with a full-featured and intuitive user interface. It provides full functionality expected from an email client including MIME support, address book, and spell checking.
useCases: Ideal for organizations wanting self-hosted webmail access with a modern interface and full email client capabilities.
